requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport's receive_messages method is returning a coroutine instead of an async iterator, causing 'async for' to fail with 'TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine' errors.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must return a proper AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be used with 'async for' loops. The method should properly yield messages asynchronously from the underlying transport.

requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method in SubprocessCLITransport has incorrect handling of AsyncIterable prompts that leads to early closure of stdin, breaking the streaming functionality for interactive clients.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method must properly handle AsyncIterable prompts without prematurely closing stdin, allowing for continued communication with the CLI subprocess.

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query method doesn't properly manage the lifecycle of the transport when using AsyncIterable prompts, causing connection issues and improper cleanup.
requirement.contract: The process_query method should correctly handle AsyncIterable prompts by managing transport connection and disconnection properly, ensuring all messages are processed and transport is cleaned up correctly.

requirement.description: ClaudeSDKClient's connect method creates an empty stream incorrectly, which prevents proper initialization of the transport for interactive use.
requirement.contract: The connect method should properly initialize the transport with either a provided prompt or an empty async iterable that allows for continued communication.

requirement.description: The _send_control_request method in SubprocessCLITransport has an issue with handling control responses that causes the interrupt functionality to fail.
requirement.contract: The _send_control_request method should properly send control requests and wait for responses, ensuring that interrupt functionality works correctly.
